## Plants with teeth

A summary of our work in [PNAS](https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2306268120) on carnivorous pitcher plants (*Nepenthes*). For more, see the Mathematical Institute [snippet](https://www.maths.ox.ac.uk/node/64967), or listen to the podcast [*Modeling illuminates pitcher plant evolution*](https://www.pnas.org/post/podcast/modeling-illuminates-pitcher-plant-evolution).
